answer: Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The pulse panel is drawn blind, the inlet escrow settles at close, and jetty lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 21% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 166 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
